life_line.name: Life Line
life_line.description: Represents vitality, physical health, major life events, and foundational energy.

deep_long.title: Deep & Long Arc
deep_long.meaning: Exceptional vitality, strong immune resilience, grounded physical presence, and steady long-term endurance.

curved_around_thumb.title: Wide Sweep Around Venus Mount
curved_around_thumb.meaning: High enthusiasm for life, deep emotional capacity, warmth, and strong ancestral protection.

chained_or_faint.title: Chained or Feathered Pattern
chained_or_faint.meaning: Fluctuating physical energy, heightened sensitivity to stress, requiring structured rest and holistic balance.

branched_upward.title: Upward Branching Offshoots
branched_upward.meaning: Periods of self-initiated breakthroughs, career ambition triumphs, and rising personal autonomy.

head_line.name: Head Line
head_line.description: Reflects cognitive style, intellectual focus, decision-making, and psychological flexibility.

straight_clear.title: Straight & Extended Across Palm
straight_clear.meaning: Analytical clarity, pragmatic problem solving, logical rigor, and high focus under pressure.

sloping_downward.title: Curved Toward Mount of Moon
sloping_downward.meaning: Vivid imagination, creative synthesis, artistic talent, and strong intuitive reasoning.

forked_writer_fork.title: Forked Terminal (Writer's Fork)
forked_writer_fork.meaning: Dual mental capacity—combining practical business acumen with imaginative creative vision.

heart_line.name: Heart Line
heart_line.description: Gauges emotional depth, romantic affinity, empathy, and interpersonal connection style.

curving_to_jupiter.title: Curving Upward to Index Finger (Jupiter)
curving_to_jupiter.meaning: Idealistic romantic values, profound empathy, loyalty, and generous emotional expression.

straight_horizontal.title: Straight Across Mounts
straight_horizontal.meaning: Controlled emotional expression, realistic boundaries, self-reliant feelings, and steady calm.

wavy_or_branched.title: Multi-Branched or Wavy Flow
wavy_or_branched.meaning: Dynamic social charm, deep emotional versatility, passionate engagement, and intense artistic sensitivity.

fate_line.name: Fate Line (Destiny Line)
fate_line.description: Indicates career focus, life orientation, sense of purpose, and external environmental alignment.

strong_straight.title: Strong & Unbroken Vertical Line
strong_straight.meaning: Clear vocation early in life, strong leadership capability, sustained professional momentum.

originating_from_moon.title: Originating from Mount of Moon
originating_from_moon.meaning: Success driven by public appeal, creative arts, counseling, or unconventional path choices.

absent_or_faint.title: Faint or Emerging Line
absent_or_faint.meaning: Unbound free-spirit path, adaptable career shifts, self-made destiny reliant on personal choice.

sun_line.name: Sun Line (Apollo Line)
sun_line.description: Governs fame, artistic brilliance, public prestige, and financial luck.

clear_prominent.title: Clear & Parallel to Fate Line
clear_prominent.meaning: High magnetic charisma, public recognition, artistic acclaim, and prosperous financial yields.

multiple_parallel.title: Multiple Parallel Sun Lines
multiple_parallel.meaning: Multitalented persona, successful multi-income channels, versatility across creative disciplines.

marriage_line.name: Marriage Line (Relationship Mark)
marriage_line.description: Reveals long-term partnership commitments and emotional milestones.

single_deep.title: Single Deep & Unbroken Line
single_deep.meaning: Profound lifelong soulmate bond, stability in romantic unions, mutual respect.

upward_curved.title: Upward Curving Toward Mercury
upward_curved.meaning: Prosperous union that elevates social and financial standing.

earth.traits: Square palm, short fingers. Grounded, practical, reliable, connected to tangible outcomes and nature.

air.traits: Square palm, long fingers. Intellectual, communicative, analytical, curious, articulate.

fire.traits: Long rectangular palm, short fingers. Energetic, passionate, charismatic, adventurous, driven.
fire.focus: Ambition, public leadership, and bold ventures.

water.traits: Long rectangular palm, long flexible fingers. Intuitive, empathetic, creative, deeply perceptive.
water.focus: Emotional mastery, artistic creation, and healing.

finger_structures.conical: Adaptable, sensitive, expressive, naturally drawn to art and design.
finger_structures.square: Systematic, orderly, punctual, valuing structure and proven methodologies.
finger_structures.spatulate: Inventive, energetic, pioneering, thriving on physical activity and discovery.
finger_structures.pointed: High spiritual alignment, delicate perception, deeply mystical outlook.
